# Coral Web Technology

> Premier software development, web development, SEO, Google Ads, and digital marketing agency based in Patna, Bihar, India.

## About Coral Web Technology
Coral Web Technology delivers full-cycle digital transformation services including custom software engineering, responsive website development, enterprise mobile applications, data analytics, and performance marketing (SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads).

## Core Services
- [Website Development](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/website-development/): Custom responsive websites, PHP, WordPress, Shopify, e-commerce stores.
- [Software Development](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/software-development/): Custom web applications, enterprise ERP, CRM, and cloud solutions.
- [Mobile App Development](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/mobile-app-development/): Android & iOS native and hybrid mobile app solutions.
- [SEO Services](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/seo/): Local SEO, national SEO, technical audits, on-page optimization, and organic ranking.
- [Google Ads & PPC](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/google-ads/): High-converting Search, Display, Remarketing, and Performance Max campaigns.
- [Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/facebook-instagram-ads/): Paid social lead generation and e-commerce scale.
- [YouTube Ads](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/youtube-ads/): Video reach, bumper ads, and in-feed video campaigns.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Brand building, content creation, reel production, and community growth.
- [Graphic & Branding](https://coralwebtechnology.com/services/graphic-&-branding.php): Logo design, brand style guides, marketing collateral.
